title: [narrowed from route-edit-15eb8508] investigate and decompose gap route-edit-4fca2558: Edit repos/discovery-vessel/src/i
description:
[narrowed from route-edit-15eb8508] investigate and decompose gap route-edit-4fca2558: Edit repos/discovery-vessel/src/index.ts to make the GET /bootstrap handler derive its anchors from the incoming request instead of returning host-dependent values. The relevant code is the app.get("/bootstrap", ...) handler, in the block that computes identity_endpoint and discovery_endpoint from PUBLIC_IP. If that file is the wrong target, say so rather than editing it.

MEASURED FAILURE. A

WHY PREVIOUS ATTEMPTS ON THIS GAP FAILED (most recent last):
- wrong_location: The patch modifies the live GET /bootstrap handler to derive endpoints from the request's Host header instead of PUBLIC_IP, addressing the gap's requirement.
- wrong_location: adversarial refuters agreed 2/2 (conf 0.90, 0.90): The patch introduces a new dependency on the 'Host' header for generating `identity_endpoint` and `discovery_endpoint` (lines 170, 173, 176). However
- semantic_reject: The patch changes the source from PUBLIC_IP to Host header but still hardcodes scheme (https/http) and ports, failing to fully derive anchors from the request

Do not repeat these failures. Address the specific cause named above.
